_note: Machine-readable map of SOC 2200. verify_course.py --course 2200 checks the prose against this file. SOC 2200 is a 2000-level survey of race and ethnicity in American society.

course.title: Race and Ethnicity in American Society

outcomes.LO1: Explain race as a social construction with real, material consequences
outcomes.LO2: Distinguish race, ethnicity, prejudice, discrimination, and racism
outcomes.LO3: Apply racial formation theory to a concrete case
outcomes.LO4: Analyse how racial categories are made, inhabited, and contested
outcomes.LO5: Evaluate empirical claims about racial inequality with primary data
outcomes.LO6: Connect a specific case of racial dynamics to general sociological theory

core_readings: OpenStax, Introduction to Sociology 3e (Rice University, 2021), ch. 11
Michael Omi and Howard Winant, Racial Formation in the United States (3rd ed., 2014)
